registration_note: Registered while the final gross-transport scalar candidate of the fresh residual screen was still running. The hazard candidate had already failed. This contract activates only if every preregistered one-coordinate residual candidate has at least one demonstrably non-equivalent pair.

activation_condition.required_condition: rootedstock_net12v3, rootedstock_social_net13v3, rootedstock_hazard_net13v3, and rootedstock_transport_net13v3 each have >0 demonstrably non-equivalent pairs under the frozen 16-branch screen
activation_condition.if_not_met: Do not activate this contract; follow the scalar-screen confirmation rule instead.

hypothesis.name: stock_flow_delay_closure
hypothesis.claim: The remaining closure residual is caused materially by committed-but-unrealized organizational throughput, especially movement orders whose effective strength is represented in current transport pressure but whose arrival/departure timing is omitted.
mechanistic_basis: inbound_transport_pressures and insurgent_transport_net_pressures count committed movement strength but discard the ETA distribution
formation movement state retains pending/moving orders, destinations, execute times, and arrival times across an anchor
closure continuations preserve inherited scheduler and movement state while replacing future RNG streams with common random numbers
organized-action/contact one-shots are also inherited future commitments and will be measured diagnostically, but are not promoted unless separately preregistered
hypothesis.falsifier: If explicit committed movement mass plus its delay moments do not eliminate demonstrable non-equivalence on a fresh screen, the first-order stock-flow-delay hypothesis is rejected as sufficient closure.

phase_1_posthoc_diagnostic.interpretation: May diagnose whether failed matched pairs differ in inherited delay-line state. Results cannot rescue the observed closure block and cannot by themselves certify the fresh delay candidate.

phase_2_fresh_screen.nomination_rule: Nominate only if zero of 24 pairs are demonstrably non-equivalent. A 16-branch result never certifies closure.
phase_2_fresh_screen.stop_rule: If one or more pairs are demonstrably non-equivalent, reject first-order delay16 as sufficient and do not accrete additional arbitrary scalar history coordinates. Move to explicit age/distributional or phase-state closure.

phase_3_fresh_confirmation.activation: Only if phase_2 has zero demonstrably non-equivalent pairs.

scientific_guard: A PASS would support a first-order stock-flow-delay reduced state only in the synthetic regime tested. It would not establish historical transport-delay validity or authorize unqualified policy ranking outside validated support.
